resources.string: We’ll show you the controls for the way you play. You can watch this again any time in Settings › About.
A gamepad, or the built-in controls of a handheld
Just your fingers on the screen
Your library, the menus and the settings.
What you need while a game is streaming.
A few things work differently when you stream from your PlayStation.
The D-pad or the left stick moves between your games and through every menu. The highlighted game is the one you’re on.
A starts the highlighted game, or opens whatever is selected: a button, a setting, a menu item.
B always takes you one step back. It closes menus and pages, and it cancels a game that is still starting.
Press B to close the menu
Down on a game opens its overview: your playtime, the details, screenshots and videos.
The right menu button opens options for the highlighted game: quit it while it runs, change its artwork, give it its own settings or hide it.
The left menu button opens the side menu: the look of DELOS, sounds and all settings.
On the start screen, L1 and R1 switch between your PCs and your PlayStation.
While you play, tap Back or Guide to open the stream menu: keyboard, performance overlay, bitrate, upscaler and more. The game doesn’t get the press.
Hold Back or Guide for half a second and your PC gets the Guide button: the Steam overlay or the Game Bar.
Disconnect leaves the game running on your PC, so you can jump back in later. Quit app closes the game on your PC, without asking.
The game keeps running on your PC
Quit app closes the game on your PC
A handheld has no touchpad or Create button. On a PlayStation stream, Select and Back stand in for them.
Swipe the row to scroll through your games.
The first tap selects a game, a second tap on it starts it. A stray tap never starts anything.
Pull a game up to open its overview: your playtime, the details, screenshots and videos.
Touch and hold a game for its options: quit it while it runs, change its artwork, give it its own settings or hide it.
Swipe in from the left edge of the screen to open the side menu: the look of DELOS, sounds and all settings.
Swipe in from the left edge
The buttons at the top open your settings, your profile and your PCs.
While you play, swipe up from the bottom edge, or use your phone’s Back gesture, to open the stream menu.
For desktop apps, set Touchscreen mode to Trackpad in the stream menu: your finger moves the cursor like on a laptop, and a tap clicks.
No controller with you? Turn on On-screen controls in the stream menu for a gamepad over the game. You can move and resize every button.
On a PlayStation stream your screen is the DualSense touchpad: swipe and tap it as you would on the controller.
Connect a PC running Vibepollo, Apollo or Sunshine, or your PlayStation.
You can watch this again any time in Settings › About.
Choose what Back does on Windows. Off: tap opens the stream menu, hold sends Guide. On: tap sends Guide, hold opens Task View. This choice is saved to your profile.
Change the switch or choose Continue
Tap Guide to open the stream menu. Back is reserved for Game Bar and Task View on Windows.
Hold Guide for half a second to send Guide to the PC. Back uses the Windows shortcuts.
